verdicts.human_summary: Watch parent directories instead of individual Git ref files to avoid inode staleness after atomic replacement by Git (unlink+rename). fs.watch() becomes bound to old inode after first update, and the fallback to directory watching only activates if initial watch fails, not if it becomes stale.
verdicts.reasoning: None of the AI comments address the inode staleness issue with fs.watch() on atomically replaced files. AI comments cover different concerns: infinite loop (Comment 0), unhandled promise rejection (Comment 1), regex whitespace (Comment 2), structural typing (Comment 3), and various style/maintainability issues (Comments 4-7). The human comment's core insight about watching directories instead of individual files to avoid platform-level inode staleness is not raised by any AI reviewer.
